unstuck_said.text: Filed issue kreditsh/x403#1: 'Support rail "xno" in the payment decision schema'. Grounded in their payment.rail field and offline-verifiable receipt property: Nano is the case where the signed pre-settlement decision is worth the most (no chargeback/clawback, instant final), a Nano block + nano_ addresses verify offline from any public node so the executor report holds, and the amount is raw atomic units (10^30/XNO). Proposed rail enum value 'xno', currency example, and a denied test vector. Carried dhyabi2/nano-invoice as the raw-unit + one-payment-per-order reference. No machine signature.
